_README: Maps Interactive Brokers local symbols to Yahoo Finance tickers.
IB reports the symbol of the venue you traded on, so the same fund on SIX,
Xetra and NASDAQ has three different IB symbols and three different Yahoo
tickers. Confirm each mapping against the ISIN — a wrong ticker charts a
different instrument and nothing will look obviously broken.
Set a value to null to keep an instrument out of the tracked book.
Regenerate a skeleton with: node scripts/import-ib.mjs private/*.csv --map-suggest
